citations.quote: We request a total allocation of $5,000,000 USDC from the Meridian DAO Community Treasury to fund the protocol acceleration and cross-chain routing initiative.

dependencies.text: Requires multi-region relayer node infrastructure and dual-oracle pricing feeds.

Proposer deflected delegate inquiries regarding milestone schedule and recipient multisig signers.
